lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy6In2 (reduced formula Dy3In) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Dy and In centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors each: Dy is surrounded by 8 Dy and 4 In neighbors, while In has 12 Dy neighbors, with neighbor distances ranging from about 3.57 to 3.62 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates Dy–Dy 12-vertex polyhedra exhibit corner, edge, and face sharing, while Dy–In and In–In pairs share edges.
